mapper.select: /* getSellerMpIvDeliChangeReqDetailPop */ SELECT A.BUYER, A.PO_NO, A.PO_SEQ, A.DS_SEQ, A.SEQ, A.PR_NO, A.PR_SEQ, A.AGENT, A.STATUS, A.TYPE, (SELECT TEXT1 FROM ICOMCOD1 WHERE TYPE = 'PMNGTYPE' AND CODE = A.TYPE) AS TYPE_TEXT, A.NOTICE_DATE, A.RE_PROCESS_TYPE, (SELECT TEXT2 FROM ICOMCOD1 WHERE TYPE = 'M034' AND CODE = A.RE_PROCESS_TYPE) AS RE_PROCESS_TYPE_TEXT, A.CH_PROCESS_TYPE, (SELECT TEXT2 FROM ICOMCOD1 WHERE TYPE = 'M034' AND CODE = A.CH_PROCESS_TYPE) AS CH_PROCESS_TYPE_TEXT, A.PARCEL_YN, DECODE(A.PARCEL_YN, 'Y', '택배', '자차') AS PARCEL_YN_TEXT, TO_CHAR(TO_DATE(A.RE_DS_DATE, 'YYYYMMDD'), 'YYYY/MM/DD') AS RE_DS_DATE, TO_CHAR(TO_DATE(A.CH_DS_DATE, 'YYYYMMDD'), 'YYYY/MM/DD') AS CH_DS_DATE, A.AGENT_REMARK, A.KEP_REMARK, A.ADD_USER_ID, A.ADD_DATE, A.CONFIRM_USER_ID, A.CONFIRM_DATE, A.CHANGE_USER_ID, A.CHANGE_DATE, (SELECT BUYER_ITEM_NO FROM ICOMPODT WHERE BUYER = A.BUYER AND PO_NO = A.PO_NO AND PO_SEQ = A.PO_SEQ) AS PO_BUYER_ITEM_NO, (SELECT TEXT2 FROM ICOMCOD1 WHERE TYPE = 'M034' AND CODE = (SELECT PROCESS_TYPE FROM ICOMPODT WHERE BUYER = A.BUYER AND PO_NO = A.PO_NO AND PO_SEQ = A.PO_SEQ)) AS PO_PROCESS_TYPE, (SELECT DESCRIPTION FROM ICOMPODT WHERE BUYER = A.BUYER AND PO_NO = A.PO_NO AND PO_SEQ = A.PO_SEQ) AS PO_DESCRIPTION, (SELECT SPECIFICATION FROM ICOMPODT WHERE BUYER = A.BUYER AND PO_NO = A.PO_NO AND PO_SEQ = A.PO_SEQ) AS PO_SPECIFICATION FROM KEP_PO_MNG A WHERE 1=1 AND A.BUYER = #{st_buyer} AND A.PO_NO = #{st_po_no} AND A.PO_SEQ = #{st_po_seq} AND A.DS_SEQ = #{st_ds_seq} AND A.SEQ = #{st_seq} AND A.AGENT = #{st_agent} AND A.TYPE = #{st_type}
